title: energizing uruguayan cucumber ceviche
description: peppery and creamy ceviche dish from uruguay featuring cucumber and tadka, halal-friendly and perfect for a hot summer day
instructions: combine cucumber slices with 1/2 cup freshly squeezed lime juice and 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
add 2 teaspoons ground cumin and 1 teaspoon paprika to the cucumber mixture
heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook 1 small onion until translucent
add 1 minced garlic clove to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
stir the cooked onion and garlic into the cucumber mixture
serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired
